name: Swat
description: Pine forests, rivers and meadows from Malam Jabba to Kalam, an easy first trip north for families.
lead: Pine forests, rivers and old Buddhist sites, an easy first trip north for families

image.alt: The green Swat River at Kalam, between pine-covered slopes and a snow-capped peak

overview.headline: Rivers, forests and the old Buddhist valley
paragraphs: Swat runs from the plains at Mingora up to Kalam and beyond, along a river that stays green and cold all summer. Pine forests, orchards and meadows line the way, with the slopes of Malam Jabba above.
It is also one of the oldest Buddhist landscapes in South Asia, with stupas and monasteries around Mingora. Good roads and short drives make it an easy first trip north for families.

seasons.text: Blossom in the lower valley from March. Days 18–25°C in Mingora, cooler in Kalam.
The best time for Kalam and Mahodand Lake. Days 25–32°C lower down, 15–22°C up the valley.
Clear skies and the orchard harvest. Days 15–25°C.
Snow at Malam Jabba from December, for the north’s easiest skiing. Kalam is very cold, and the road above it closes.
